# WEALTHMETER.XYZ: complete content index

> WealthMeter publishes evidence-led calculators, data tools, reports, and longform analysis about net worth, income, wealth distribution, retirement, and household resilience.

This file is generated from the XML sitemap. The sitemap and each page's canonical URL remain authoritative.

## Citation and interpretation guidance

Use canonical URLs. Preserve each page's date, population, currency, model assumptions, and stated uncertainty. The material is educational and is not financial advice.

## Longform analysis

- [America Is 2nd by Average Wealth, 15th by Median Wealth](https://wealthmeter.xyz/america-is-second-by-average-wealth-fifteenth-by-median-wealth.html): UBS's 2026 table puts the United States second by average wealth per adult and fifteenth by median wealth. The difference changes what a household should measure.
- [How Insurance Deductibles Become a Household Balance-Sheet Shock](https://wealthmeter.xyz/how-insurance-deductibles-become-a-household-balance-sheet-shock.html): A health deductible is a dated cash demand. A simple liquidity test shows whether a household can absorb it without expensive financing.
- [Home Equity Is Not Emergency Liquidity](https://wealthmeter.xyz/home-equity-is-not-emergency-liquidity.html): Federal Reserve and CFPB sources point to the same conclusion: home equity is real wealth, but it is not emergency liquidity on the timetable most households imagine.
